doc.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002

title: Wrapping up the interview
summary: Rowe notes Keepnews must leave, and he thanks him and asks for a copy.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I know that you have to go, and so I—

Well this has been a great pleasure. I could easily continue endlessly but I don’t know if you necessarily want me to. But I have enjoyed it. I hope all kinds of good things are made of things. And I do want to end up with a copy of what I have said.
